evals.prompt: Write a Go function `process(ctx context.Context, items []Item, workers int) error` that processes items using a fixed number of worker goroutines reading from a channel, respects context cancellation, and returns the first error encountered. Answer inline in the chat as a fenced Go code block; do not create or edit any files.
evals.expected_output: Uses errgroup (or equivalent) for waiting and first-error propagation, bounds the worker count to the `workers` parameter instead of spawning one goroutine per item, and closes the input channel only from its single sending goroutine.

assertions.text: Uses errgroup for waiting and error propagation
Uses a channel to distribute work across a bounded set of workers
Does not spawn one goroutine per item unboundedly instead of a bounded worker count
